description: This file defines the 'CommunityScreen' widget, a key UI component for a Flutter app's community feature. It manages state for community threads and matches, handles user interactions for creating threads, and displays lists of matches and discussion threads, integrating with an API service.

classes.name: CommunityScreen
classes.description: Main widget for displaying community interactions, including discussion threads and matches.

classes.name: _CommunityScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the data and interactions for CommunityScreen, including fetching data, creating threads, and building UI.

classes.name: _ThreadDetail
classes.description: Stateless widget displaying details of a selected thread.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state and triggers initial data fetch.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Releases resources held by the widget, such as controllers.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches community threads and match candidates asynchronously from API.

methods.name: _createThread
methods.description: Creates a new thread locally with the input text and clears the input field.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the CommunityScreen UI.
